overview_description.description: SESO is a labor marketplace for agriculture.  U.S. agriculture loses $15B annually because of a shortage of labor. The company is addressing this problem by connecting U.S. farms with qualified seasonal workers via America’s agricultural guest worker program (H-2A). Our service offering includes recruiting, qualifying, and training workers; H-2A visa automation, and workforce management software to help employers stay compliant with complex local and federal laws. We are providing agricultural employers with a better quality workforce at a lower cost and agricultural workers with meaningful, safe employment opportunities.

about_short_description.short_description: SESO is an AI-powered workforce platform that helps agricultural employers access labor and streamline workforce management.

product.name: Seso HR Platform
product.description: A cloud-based human resources platform designed for agricultural employers to manage employee data, operations, and compliance in one system.

product.name: Digital Worker Onboarding
product.description: A digital onboarding system for H-2A and domestic agricultural workers that automates I-9, W-4, and custom hiring packet completion with E-Verify integration.

product.name: H-2A Filing & Compliance Software
product.description: Software that assists agricultural employers in managing and streamlining the H-2A visa application, filing, and compliance processes.

product.name: Payroll Services for Agriculture
product.description: Payroll processing services tailored for agricultural employers, available as self-serve or managed options to handle wage calculations and tax filings.

product.name: Pay Card Services
product.description: A prepaid payroll card solution that enables agricultural workers to receive wages electronically, replacing paper checks and paystubs.

product.name: H-2A Worker Services
product.description: Consulate scheduling, recruiting, and logistics management services for H-2A workers, provided by Seso's team in Monterrey, Mexico.
